name: How long does it take to replace cabinet hardware?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to replace cabinet hardware?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to replace cabinet hardware depends on the number of cabinets, the complexity of the existing and new hardware, and whether any modifications are needed. For a typical kitchen with standard knobs or pulls, a professional can often complete the replacement in a few hours. If you're upgrading to specialty hinges or drawer slides that require precise alignment or drilling, the process may take longer. We can provide a more accurate timeframe once we understand the scope of your specific cabinet hardware replacement project.
acceptedAnswer.description: Replacement time varies by the number of cabinets and hardware complexity. A typical kitchen can take a few hours; complex upgrades may take longer.
